decisions.decision: Use WKG_NETSUITE_VK.csv (the prod-canonical Jan 2026 seed, 95103 rows) as the UAT and prod corpus instead of the alphabetically-first Feb 2026 CSV that was being picked
decisions.rationale: User confirmed this was the EXACT file used to seed prod originally. Lines = 95104 (95103 data + header) which exactly matches GOLDEN_SALES_RECORDS=95103. Sales gross revenue against this corpus is £1,783,083.58, exact match to GOLDEN_TOTAL_REVENUE_GROSS_GBP.

decisions.decision: Pre-seed canonical fee fallbacks (Booking Fee→9991, Cash Handling Fee→9992) inside Phase 1's atomic tx
decisions.rationale: Without these, 47k of 95k sales rows reject at staging because the upstream NetSuite export elides Code on WKG-collected fee rows. Mappings sourced from src/lib/csv/sales-csv.ts:180-183 and src/lib/commission/processor.ts:109.

decisions.decision: Phase 1 → Phase 2 connection swap in scripts/v2-wipe-and-reseed.ts
decisions.rationale: Single PoolClient held for ~6 min during Phase 1's Monday GraphQL fan-out gets killed mid-Phase-2 95k-row INSERT by Neon's serverless connection idle/duration limits. Swap to a fresh client after Phase 1 commits, re-acquire advisory lock on the new session.

decisions.decision: Heathrow Express SSMs board (1356657751) imported via dedicated runHeathrowImport, not generalised into runHotelLocationImport
decisions.rationale: Structurally different shape: outlet_code1 (text, slash-separated) instead of mirror9 (mirror, comma-separated); items mix transit venues with hotels; zero Assets cross-references so kiosks must be synthesised inline. Separation keeps both importers focused.

decisions.decision: Ready to Launch group hotels imported as placeholder locations (no kiosks, NULL customer_code, monday_item_id set)
decisions.rationale: Operator decision: import them as locations now even without outlet codes / Assets entries; kiosks attach when actual install happens. Region resolved per-item from the LocationValue's trailing country token (e.g. 'UK', 'Germany') since 'Ready to Launch' as a group title doesn't resolve.

decisions.decision: Path B (full restructure) — drop locations.outlet_code entirely; customer_code is the canonical hotel-account identifier
decisions.rationale: Domain model correction: outlet_code is per-kiosk (used in bookings); customer_code is per-hotel (RPS account number, mirrored from Assets). 364 of 380 locations have customer_code populated on UAT after Plan 07-06; placeholder rows correctly carry NULL. 4 same-name + customer_code conflicts deferred to operator merge UI (similarity-check workflow).

decisions.decision: locations.monday_item_id added as universal importer idempotency key
decisions.rationale: Replaces the (region, outlet_code) ON CONFLICT target. Every Monday item has a stable id; works for hotels with customer_code AND placeholders without. Partial unique index (WHERE monday_item_id IS NOT NULL) allows historical legacy rows to coexist.

decisions.decision: Sentinel re-keyed from outlet_code='__LOCATION_NEEDED__' to (name='LOCATION_NEEDED', region=GLOBAL)
decisions.rationale: outlet_code dropped from locations table; sentinel must use a still-existing key. The GLOBAL region is unambiguous (only one sentinel row per DB).
